recitals: Data Provider owns confidential patient health data stored in their private AWS cloud infrastructure
Model Trainer desires to train a diagnostic AI model using said confidential data from their Azure cloud environment
CCRP will provide secure, isolated multi-cloud environment with cross-cloud privacy-preserving infrastructure
All parties agree to maintain strict confidentiality and comply with healthcare regulations across different cloud environments
Training environment must coordinate KMS and storage across multiple cloud providers
Cross-cloud training execution with secure data transfer and key coordination will be employed

terms.title: Multi-Tenant Data Provision
terms.content: Data Provider agrees to provide confidential patient health dataset (DS-MEDICAL-2024-001) from their AWS S3 storage, encrypted using AWS KMS keys, for the purpose of training a diagnostic AI model. Data will be securely transferred to CCRP's multi-cloud environment using cross-cloud encryption protocols. All data shall be de-identified in accordance with HIPAA requirements and DPDP Act 2023 standards.

terms.title: Multi-Cloud Training Environment
terms.content: CCRP shall provide a secure, isolated multi-cloud environment with cross-cloud privacy-preserving infrastructure meeting the following specifications: (a) Multi-cloud orchestration supporting AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premises infrastructure, (b) Cross-cloud KMS coordination for secure key management, (c) Unified storage gateway for accessing data across different cloud providers, (d) Secure data transfer protocols between different cloud environments, (e) Tenant isolation with complete security separation, (f) Cross-cloud monitoring and audit logging.

terms.title: Cross-Cloud Model Training Specifications
terms.content: Model Trainer shall train a diagnostic AI model using cross-cloud privacy-preserving techniques: (a) Model type: Multi-class classification for disease diagnosis, (b) Training approach: Cross-cloud federated learning with secure aggregation, (c) Privacy techniques: Differential privacy (ε=0.1, δ=1e-5), secure multiparty computation across clouds, (d) Target accuracy: Minimum 95% on validation set, (e) Training framework: TensorFlow with cross-cloud privacy-preserving extensions, (f) Cross-cloud validation metrics: Precision, Recall, F1-Score, AUC-ROC with privacy-preserving validation, (g) Training duration: Maximum 30 days, (h) Cross-cloud model validation: Secure multiparty validation across different cloud environments.

terms.title: Multi-Cloud Security and Privacy
terms.content: All parties agree to implement comprehensive multi-cloud privacy-preserving measures: (a) Cross-cloud data encryption using tenant-specific KMS providers, (b) Secure key coordination across different KMS systems, (c) Unified storage access with tenant-specific storage providers, (d) Cross-cloud network isolation with secure bridges, (e) Regular security audits across all cloud environments, (f) Privacy budget tracking across multiple cloud providers, (g) Cross-cloud membership inference attack protection, (h) Multi-cloud privacy-preserving analytics and aggregation.

terms.title: Cross-Cloud Payment and Compensation
terms.content: Model Trainer agrees to pay Data Provider $50,000 USD for dataset access and CCRP $25,000 USD for multi-cloud secure environment provision. Payment shall be made in installments: 50% upon contract activation, 30% upon successful cross-cloud model training, 20% upon final model delivery and cross-cloud privacy-preserving validation.

terms.title: Multi-Cloud Intellectual Property Rights
terms.content: Data Provider retains ownership of original dataset in their AWS environment. Model Trainer shall own the trained model but may not redistribute the original data. CCRP shall have no rights to data or model. All parties agree to maintain confidentiality of shared information for 5 years beyond contract completion. Cross-cloud privacy-preserving techniques and infrastructure remain proprietary to respective parties.

terms.title: Multi-Cloud Compliance and Regulatory Requirements
terms.content: All parties shall comply with: (a) DPDP Act 2023 for data protection across multiple cloud environments, (b) HIPAA for healthcare data privacy with cross-cloud de-identification, (c) GDPR for international data transfers with multi-cloud privacy impact assessments, (d) ISO 27001 for information security across multiple cloud providers, (e) SOC 2 for service organization controls with multi-cloud privacy criteria, (f) Local healthcare regulations and medical device standards with cross-cloud privacy-preserving validation.

terms.title: Multi-Cloud Liability and Indemnification
terms.content: Each party shall indemnify others against claims arising from their breach of this agreement. Data Provider warrants data quality and legal right to share with multi-cloud privacy compliance. Model Trainer warrants cross-cloud privacy-preserving training methodology and techniques. CCRP warrants multi-cloud security infrastructure and cross-cloud privacy-preserving environment isolation.

terms.title: Cross-Cloud Training and Compliance
terms.content: All parties agree to implement comprehensive cross-cloud privacy-preserving techniques: (a) Multi-cloud federated learning with secure aggregation protocols, (b) Cross-cloud differential privacy with epsilon-delta parameters (ε=0.1, δ=1e-5), (c) Secure multiparty computation across different cloud environments, (d) Cross-cloud homomorphic encryption for encrypted model training, (e) Zero-knowledge proofs for privacy verification across clouds, (f) Multi-cloud privacy budget tracking and alerting systems, (g) Cross-cloud membership inference attack protection, (h) Regular privacy impact assessments across all cloud environments, (i) Cross-cloud incident response procedures for privacy breaches, (j) Compliance with DPDP 2023, GDPR, and HIPAA regulations across multiple cloud providers.
